summary: Perfect Moment Ltd., an OTCQB-listed apparel maker, filed an 8-K reporting an October 9, 2026 Second Amendment and Limited Waiver to its March 30, 2026 loan agreement with X3 Higher Moment Fund LLC as administrative agent. The amendment raises X3's revolving commitment from $8.0 million to $9.5 million, lifting the aggregate revolving commitment from $10.0 million to $11.5 million. A Key Person Event has occurred and the company sought a limited waiver. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, or premium applies; this is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation.
